'''Haunted Ship''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Haunted Ship}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Haunt
|Intent = StatusCard
|Effect = Shuffles 5 {{C2|Dazed}} into your discard pile. Applies 3 {{BD2|Weak}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Weak
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Swipe
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|14}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Stomp
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (4;{{Asc2|9|5}}) damage ×3.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always uses {{Int2|Haunted Ship|Haunt}} first.

From the second turn onward, alternates between {{Int2|Haunted Ship|Swipe}} and {{Int2|Haunted Ship|Stomp}}, always starting with {{Int2|Haunted Ship|Swipe}}.
